    Network meta-analysis tibbles

    Source: R/classes-vctrs.R
    new_meta_nma.Rd

    new_meta_nma() is the low-level constructor for <meta_nma>, the class returned by meta_network(). Each row is a treatment, with its effect relative to the reference treatment and its P-score. The full network (all pairwise comparisons, heterogeneity, inconsistency and the direct and indirect evidence split) is kept in the "nma" attribute and is returned by tidy() and glance().

    Usage

    new_meta_nma(x, nma = list())

is_meta_nma(x)

    Arguments

    x

    A data frame of treatment effects.

    nma

    A named list of network internals.

    Value

    new_meta_nma() returns a <meta_nma>. is_meta_nma() returns a single logical value.

    Examples

    pw <- meta_pairwise(smoking_cessation, study = study, treatment = trt,
  measure = "OR", event = xi, n = ni)
nma <- meta_network(pw, study = study, treat1 = treat1, treat2 = treat2)
is_meta_nma(nma)
#> [1] TRUE
